Products I've designed

Casino and sportsbook platforms, a mobile poker app, an agentic payments OS and a Web3 game marketplace. Consumer and B2B, desktop and mobile, each built on its own design system.

CASINO

Casino · Player lobby

Goldvein Casino

A crypto-friendly casino lobby: originals, slots, recent wins and a live chat on one screen. Dark interface with a single gold accent, so every action reads at a glance.

  • Lobby UX
  • Originals
  • Live chat
  • Design system

SPORTS

Sportsbook · Pre-match & live

Strikeline Sportsbook

A sportsbook home with a sport rail, upcoming matches with live odds and a community chat. Odds change state in colour, so movement is visible without reading numbers.

  • Betting UX
  • Live odds
  • Community
  • Responsive

MOBILE

Mobile · Social poker app

AcePoint Poker

A social poker app for iOS and Android: tables, tournaments and a chip store. Thumb-first controls, large legible cards and a clear turn timer, so a hand reads instantly on a small screen.

  • Mobile app
  • Game UI
  • In-app store
  • iOS & Android
